name: Doubao
tagline: ByteDance's free AI assistant for chat, writing, and documents.
description: Doubao (豆包) is ByteDance's consumer AI assistant for everyday Q&A, content creation, document processing, translation, coding help, and multimodal interaction. Core features — dialogue, basic creation, document summarization, and translation — are free with no ads or paywalls. It runs on ByteDance's own Doubao models.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on ByteDance's in-house Doubao models.

edge: China's most-used AI assistant, with 330M+ users by mid-2026, and free where rivals meter or charge.
